purpose: Prototype v1 of the works from keystrokes: synthetic English keystrokes of four texts written for this purpose, one tile per 30 s window in time order, through the form of the rule (decision 2 of .steering/20261031-keystroke-design: p and q from keystrokes, not called valence or arousal). Two generators on equal terms (from the text; regimes without a text) and the gaps of each text series shuffled. Written before any keystroke series was generated.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-31 after: the texts (decision 2 of .steering/20261031-synthetic-prototype), the four corner tiles of the rule without keystroke values (decision 4), the literature (decision 3). No synthetic keystroke series of these texts and no window value had been computed.

keystrokes.unit: press time in ms; no key, character or release

text_timing.source: decision 3 of .steering/20261031-synthetic-prototype: Dhakal et al. 2018 (mean IKI 238.66 ms) and the mixture of Baaijen et al. 2012 cited by Van Waes et al. 2021 (330, 735, 2697 ms); paragraph_end and the sigmas assumed

regimes.rest_chance: per text: (sentence_end + paragraph_end presses) / gaps of the text, from its structure only
regimes.presses: per text: the number of presses of the text
regimes.source: assumed (decision 4 of .steering/20261031-keystroke-design: statistics and switching of regimes only)

windows.speed: median of gaps < rest_ms with both presses in the window (GSE features.rs F1)
windows.rest: share of the window's time inside gaps >= rest_ms (GSE features.rs F5 counts them)

mapping.form: atact.mapping coefficients: f = F0 + F1 p, s = S0 + S1 q, gamma = G0 + G1 (WP p + WQ q)

external.source: Dhakal et al. 2018, Table 3 (slow and fast typists' mean IKI); decision 5

mapping.minmax: reference only: per series, ln m and rest share each min-max to [0, 1] over its windows, then p and q as above (decision 5)

relief.grey: H / (2 s_max) + 1/2, as the common scale of the works of words (no STL: images only)

figure.rows: per text: from_text, shuffled, regimes (seed index 0 of each)

counts: per series: the share of [0, 1] spanned by the middle half (first to third quartile) of p and of q over the windows, under the external scale, for every seed and generator; fixed before running (recommendation 2 of the works of words)
